items.title: Amazon EC2 P6-B300 instances are now available in additional AWS Regions
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Cloud Compute (Amazon EC2) P6-B300 instances are available in Asia Pacific (Hyderabad) and South America (Sao Paulo) Regions.

items.title: Amazon Aurora MySQL 3.13 (compatible with MySQL 8.0.45) is generally available
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon Aurora MySQL-Compatible Edition 3 (compatible with MySQL 8.0) supports MySQL 8.0.45, which includes community MySQL fixes and Aurora-specific improvements.

items.title: Amazon CloudWatch agent adds support for journald logs
items.blurb: AWS announces support for collecting systemd journal (journald) logs with the Amazon CloudWatch agent.

items.title: Amazon Redshift streaming can now ingest 10MiB records from Amazon Kinesis Data Streams
items.blurb: Amazon Redshift now supports Amazon Kinesis Data Streams (KDS) record sizes up to 10 MiB—a 10x increase from the previous 1 MiB limit—fully matching the expanded maximum record size in Amazon KDS.

items.title: Cosmos3-Edge, Cosmos3-Nano, and Cosmos3-Super models now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
items.blurb: NVIDIA's Cosmos3-Edge, Cosmos3-Nano, and Cosmos3-Super models are now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, expanding the portfolio of foundation models available to AWS customers.

items.title: Muse-Glimmer-30B and Qwen 3.8-27B models now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
items.blurb: Meta's Muse-Glimmer-30B and Alibaba's Qwen 3.8-27B models are now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, expanding the portfolio of foundation models available to AWS customers.

items.title: I used AWS cognito for a startup. I wouldn't do it again
items.blurb: I let AWS Cognito gaslight me for three weeks so you don't have to. Here's the unfiltered autopsy.

items.title: AKS Looks to Make Node Disruption More Predictable with New NAP Guidance
items.blurb: Microsoft is placing greater emphasis on controlling disruption in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) Node Auto-Provisioning (NAP), publishing new guidance to help platform teams balance the efficiency benefits of automated node consolidation…
